globalSettings.title: Global Settings
globalSettings.decimalSeparatorDesc: Defines how decimal values are typed in admin forms (including currency amount format).
globalSettings.pythonPathDesc: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used by the code interpreter tool. Leave empty to auto-detect from known system locations.
globalSettings.pythonRequirementsDesc: requirements.txt-style declaration of Python packages the Code Interpreter sandbox auto-installs before every Custom Tool that calls code.executePython(...). One package per line, optionally version-pinned (e.g. reportlab==4.0.7). Blank disables auto-install. Packages are cached per-hash, so identical content never re-installs. AI Agents may add their own per-agent requirements that get unioned with this baseline.
globalSettings.codeInterpreterModeDesc: Where the Code Interpreter runs Python. Native runs it as a host subprocess (fast, no isolation). Docker runs each execution inside a throwaway hardened container (no network, dropped capabilities, only the session directory mounted) — recommended for multi-tenant or untrusted custom tools.
globalSettings.codeInterpreterImageDesc: Image used to run each execution when Docker mode is active. Should bundle Python plus the packages your agents rely on (reportlab, matplotlib, qrcode, …). Defaults to python:3.12-slim; most deployments publish their own image.
globalSettings.codeInterpreterSkillImageDesc: Image for the Anthropic-compatible skill session — a bash-driven container with the skill folder mounted that the model drives across turns. Should bundle python + node + bash to match Anthropic's skill container. Defaults to python:3.12-slim; publish your own to add node or extra tools.
globalSettings.piiSlotDesc: Slots whose names start with the `pii_` prefix are encrypted at rest, redacted in logs/audit, and wiped after this retention window. Adjust to match your LGPD/GDPR posture.
globalSettings.piiSlotTtlDesc: Hourly cleanup wipes pii_* slot values older than this. Use 0 to disable retention enforcement (slots remain encrypted at rest and redacted in logs). Maximum 8760 (one year).
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretDesc: HMAC secret used to sign download URLs emitted by the Code Interpreter file API. Auto-generated on first boot; rotate when a leak is suspected. The actual value never leaves the server — this page only shows whether it's set.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretStatusConfigured: A signing secret is configured. Download URLs are signed.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretStatusBlank: No signing secret is set. Downloads work, but URLs are unsigned — anyone with the link can fetch the file.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretRotateConfirm: Rotate the URL signing secret? This invalidates every previously emitted signed download URL across the fleet. Visitors with an old link will see a 403.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretRotateSuccess: URL signing secret regenerated. Previous links are now invalid.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretRotateFailed: Failed to regenerate the URL signing secret.
globalSettings.urlSigningSecretPreview: New secret minted (preview: {{preview}}…). The full value stays on the server.
globalSettings.llmSettingsDesc: Language model instance and cache configuration for reports, insights, and emails.
globalSettings.defaultLlmDesc: LLM instance used for AI suggestions across all screens (e.g., log analysis, monitoring summaries).
globalSettings.defaultAiAgentDesc: AI Agent used by default in chat experiences when no agent is explicitly selected.
globalSettings.llmCacheDesc: Enable caching of LLM responses for reports, insights, and emails to reduce API calls and improve response time.
globalSettings.cacheDurationDesc: How long cached LLM responses remain valid before a new request is made.
globalSettings.regenerateCacheDesc: Force a new LLM call on the next request, ignoring any existing cache. The cache will be recreated with the fresh response.
globalSettings.ragSettingsDesc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for asset indexing and knowledge base.
globalSettings.enableRagDesc: Enables automatic embedding indexing of files stored in Assets (MinIO). Requires an Embedding Model and Store to be configured below.
globalSettings.embeddingModelRequired: Embedding Model is required when RAG is enabled
globalSettings.defaultEmbeddingModelDesc: Model used to generate vector embeddings for asset content.
globalSettings.embeddingStoreRequired: Embedding Store is required when RAG is enabled
globalSettings.defaultEmbeddingStoreDesc: Vector database where asset embeddings are stored and queried.
globalSettings.rerankDesc: Re-order retrieved chunks by relevance before sending them to the model. Off by default; never makes retrieval worse (fails open to retrieval order).
globalSettings.rerankEnableDesc: Run a reranking stage over the hybrid retrieval results before stuffing the prompt.
globalSettings.rerankTopNDesc: How many of the highest-ranked chunks to keep for the prompt (1–100).
globalSettings.rerankModelDesc: Rerank model name. Blank uses the backend default.
globalSettings.rerankEndpointDesc: Self-hosted /rerank endpoint (Text Embeddings Inference, Infinity, or Jina-compatible).
globalSettings.rerankApiKeyDesc: API key for the Cohere Rerank API. Stored encrypted.
globalSettings.rerankApiKeySetDesc: A key is configured. Leave blank to keep it; type a new value to replace it.
globalSettings.emailSettingsDesc: Configure email service for notifications and weekly reports.
globalSettings.emailProviderDesc: Service used to send transactional emails.
globalSettings.apiKeyDesc: API key for the selected email provider.
globalSettings.senderEmailDesc: Email address used as the sender for outgoing emails.
globalSettings.senderNameDesc: Display name shown as the sender (e.g., "Viglet Turing").
globalSettings.recipientEmailDesc: Default recipient for automated reports (e.g., weekly search report).
globalSettings.testEmailHint: Save settings before testing to use the latest configuration.
globalSettings.loadFailed: Failed to load global settings. Using default values.
globalSettings.testEmailFailed: Failed to send test email. Check your email settings.
